text:
Mia: Quick question — preflight checklist for onboarding Acme Corp (low-latency chat). They want <200ms p99 and expect bursty traffic. Any recommended defaults for prefetch/cache/batch/streaming? Also renewal risk flagged if p95 > 250ms.
Jordan: TL;DR: enable streaming, small batch sizes for p99, aggressive prefetch warmup, per-route cache for system prompt + static context. I'll paste a quick config.
Jordan: config snippet: ```yaml
prefetch:
  warmup_sessions: 5
  concurrent_warmups_per_host: 2
cache:
  ttl_seconds: 120
  shard_by: user_id
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_requests: 8
streaming: true
fallback_model: redwood-2.7b-quant
```
Keiko: +1. Also set KV cache reuse for chat turns and use token-based throttling to keep latency stable. For bursts, enable burst capacity with reserved nodes and configure graceful fallback to a smaller model for background ops.
Sam: For enablement, share a short checklist with the customer: integration tests, latency SLOs, synthetic traffic pattern, QA prompts, and where to find the console metrics. I can draft a 1-page checklist.
Mia: Can we add a tiny synthetic warmup snippet? e.g., curl loop to generate representative chat turns.
Jordan: here's a quick script: ```bash
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}], "context_id":"warmup-'$i'"}';
  sleep 0.12;
done
```
CS-bot: Reminder: add to onboarding checklist — capture signals `prefetch_success_ratio`, `p95_latency`, `p99_latency`, and `cache_hit_rate` in Console within first 24h.
Keiko: For renewal risk: if prefetch_success_ratio < 0.8 after 48h, escalate to AM and propose a 2-week dedicated warmup window. Also enable an alert rule: p99 > 220ms for 30m -> page on-call + notify AM.
Sam: I'll own the enablement doc. Assigning follow-ups: Mia (customer comms & meeting), Jordan (config template + warmup scripts), Keiko (monitoring & alert rules).
Mia: Got it. I'll ping Acme for a 30-min kickoff tomorrow and drop the enablement doc link after Jordan shares the template. :thumbsup:
